t0003-01.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
t0003-01.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

t0003-02.gloss: Seed stock and a freshly used tool were wrapped together.
t0003-02.rival_reading: A response crew could move seed stock and tools while clearing a farm; the clean grip could come from ordinary handling.
